chunks: Their requital will be Hell, because they disbelieved and mocked My signs and messengers.
ai.seo_question: Why is Hell the specific punishment for those who mocked God's signs and messengers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Kahf highlights the progression from mere disbelief to the active mockery of divine revelation, a state that seals the fate of the disbelievers. The term 'Huzu' (mockery) signifies not just ridicule but a profound dismissal of the truth's authority, leading to the eternal punishment of Jahannam as a just recompense for their spiritual arrogance.
